title: Agent/prompt tests — Epic-5 acceptance/consolidation pass (debater prompts list skills; controller prompt has no stance leak; relay framing adversarial; over-limit output trimmed)
prompt:
Write tests asserting: debater prompts list their skills; controller prompt contains no stance leak; relay framing is adversarial; over-limit output is trimmed.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note:
Epic-5 acceptance/consolidation pass (mirrors 1.5/2.5/3.6/7.5/13.7): a CONSOLIDATED agent acceptance module asserting the four headline anti-sycophancy behaviours END-TO-END through the public agent_debate.core API as one integrated story. NEW TEST FILE packages/core/tests/test_agents_acceptance.py (5 tests, <=150 code lines): (1) both Pro AND Con built agents' system prompts list every named DEBATER_SKILL; (2) the controller prompt mirrors 'never reveal' AND leaks no pre-held stance (no 'i think'/'i believe'/'i lean'/'in my opinion'/'is right'); (3) relay framing is the adversarial «»/rebut frame, the sanitised opponent message lands as a USER turn in the agent's OWN context and the opponent's context stays empty (5.4 isolation), and a smuggled injection is neutralised before framing; (4) over-MAX_WORDS output is trimmed to exactly the (config-driven) limit and logs a 'system' word_limit violation to a tmp runs_dir. TestModel only (no network/key); max_words read from Settings, side labels from constants.

HONEST net-new vs already-covered: the agents subpackage was ALREADY ~100% covered by the per-task suites (5.1-5.7), so almost none of the UNIT behaviour is net-new. The genuine value here is (a) the integrated acceptance COMPOSITION (the four guarantees asserted together, through one public-API import) and (b) a real GAP FIX surfaced by writing the acceptance test public-API-first.

SOURCE FIX (minimal, genuine gap): the relay + word-limit symbols (relay_opponent_turn, build_adversarial_relay, enforce_word_limit, count_words, WordLimitResult, anchor_turn, build_side_anchor, ADVERSARIAL_RELAY_TEMPLATE, ANTI_CONCESSION_RULE) were NOT re-exported from the top-level agent_debate.core hub (only from the agents subpackage) — so the four headline behaviours could not be asserted 'through the public agent_debate.core API' as the issue requires. TDD red-first: wrote test_agents_acceptance.py importing those names from agent_debate.core and watched it fail (ImportError: cannot import name 'ADVERSARIAL_RELAY_TEMPLATE' from agent_debate.core), then added the 9 re-exports to green. Because the core/__init__.py aggregation hub already sat AT the 150-code-line limit, adding the names directly pushed it to 167 code lines (over §3.2). Remedy = SPLIT not compress: factored the agents re-export group into a new shim packages/core/src/agent_debate/core/_agents_public.py (explicit imports from agents + an explicit, mypy-checked __all__ of 21 names) and pull it into __init__ via a single `from ._agents_public import *`; __init__'s own literal __all__ lists all 79 names (70 original + 9 new) so ruff F822/mypy implicit-reexport still see them. Added a scoped [tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores] for that one hub __init__.py = [F403, F405] (the star-import lints) — the re-export is still fully type-checked via the shim's explicit __all__. No behaviour change; purely surfacing already-built symbols on the documented public API.

API gatekeeper (Epic 13): N/A — pure prompt-text/relay/word-limit + the LOG sink, no network call (TestModel). Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check = All checks passed; ruff format --check clean (117 files); mypy = no issues in 117 source files; pytest --cov = 312 passed, total coverage 99% (>=85); check_line_limit pass (no file over 150 code lines, incl. the re-split hub __init__); secret_scan pass. See PR CI for the authoritative result.
